[ez5] Service.UploadReadings                   fn     go  srcgo/internal/ingest/service.go:38-56
    38 func (s *Service) UploadReadings(ctx context.Context, batch *telemetry.ReadingBatch) (*telemetry.IngestAck, error) {
    39 	if batch == nil {
    40 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty batch")
    41 	}
    42 	if len(batch.Readings) > maxBatch {
    43 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("batch of %d exceeds the limit of %d", len(batch.Readings), maxBatch)
    44 	}
    45 	ack := &telemetry.IngestAck{}
    46 	for _, r := range batch.Readings {
    47 		if !s.accept(ctx, r) {
    48 			ack.Rejected++
    49 			continue
    50 		}
    51 		ack.Accepted++
    52 	}
    53 	s.accepted += ack.Accepted
    54 	s.rejected += ack.Rejected
    55 	return ack, nil
    56 }
suppressed: none
unknown: none
stale: none
